summary: ParaZero Technologies filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release dated November 2, 2026, announcing receipt of a fourth order for DefendAir Net Pods from a Tier-1 European defense company. No price, stake, or financial terms were disclosed. The order follows a live demonstration on the customer's own armored vehicle at its European test facility, continuing collaboration under a September 2026 memorandum of understanding. Integration trials and demonstrations for senior NATO member-state military officers are expected by year-end 2026. This is an ordinary commercial/order announcement, not a special situation; no deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arb angle apply.
